_about: Realm Inputs RI-0 (Oct 15 2026). One lens per xpSeason realm: what Oracle looks for in an input taken in for that realm, what its 1-10 score means, and the kind of quest it suggests. Read by the video analyser (local_server/rpgace_intel.py, run by the cloud runner and the laptop server) and the app (book chapters, screenshots). Edit here only. Draft v1, awaiting Alex's corrections.

producer.name: Producer
producer.looks_for: Concrete beat-making knowledge: melody and chord choices, drum and 808 programming, sound design, sampling, mixing and mastering moves, FL Studio workflow, arrangement. Name exact settings, plugins, patterns and why they work.
producer.score_means: How much this would improve the next beat Alex makes. 10 = a technique he can use tonight that clearly levels up his sound; 1 = nothing usable.
producer.quest_style: A short studio task: recreate, flip or apply one technique in a beat.

creator.name: Creator
creator.looks_for: Content craft: hooks, pacing, editing, thumbnails, titles, visual style, storytelling, platform formats (YouTube, Shorts, TikTok, Instagram) and what made this piece hold attention.
creator.score_means: How much this would improve the next video or post Alex makes. 10 = a format or hook he should copy now; 1 = nothing to learn for his content.
creator.quest_style: Make or plan one post or video using the idea.

hustler.name: Hustler
hustler.looks_for: Making money from music: beat selling, licensing, pricing, outreach to artists, collabs, marketing, distribution, business systems. Real numbers and tactics over hype.
hustler.score_means: How directly this could lead to a sale, placement or paying collab. 10 = a tactic with a clear money path; 1 = vague motivation dressed as business.
hustler.quest_style: One outreach, listing, pricing or marketing action.

chef.name: Chef
chef.looks_for: Cooking: techniques, recipes, ingredients and substitutes, cuisines, meal prep, kitchen skills, food science that explains why a method works.
chef.score_means: How much this would improve what Alex cooks this week. 10 = a dish or technique he will actually make; 1 = food entertainment with nothing to cook.
chef.quest_style: Cook, prep or try one dish or technique.

athlete.name: Athlete
athlete.looks_for: Training and body: exercises and form cues, programming, progression, nutrition, recovery, sleep for performance. Evidence-based over bro-science.
athlete.score_means: How much this would improve his training or health if applied. 10 = a clear, safe change to his programme; 1 = no usable advice.
athlete.quest_style: Add one exercise, cue or habit to the next session.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.looks_for: Learning itself: clear explanations, frameworks, ideas worth remembering, how to study and retain, references to go deeper.
scholar.score_means: How much real understanding this adds. 10 = a framework he will reuse; 1 = shallow or repeated knowledge.
scholar.quest_style: Explain it back, make recall cards or read the source it cites.

life.name: Life
life.looks_for: Running a good life: routines, planning, priorities, relationships with self, life admin, balancing work, music and rest.
life.score_means: How much this would make his days run better. 10 = a change to his routine he should adopt; 1 = generic life advice.
life.quest_style: Adjust one routine or plan one thing for the week.

homekeeper.name: Homekeeper
homekeeper.looks_for: The home: cleaning systems, organising, maintenance, laundry, DIY, setting up spaces (including the studio) to work better.
homekeeper.score_means: How much easier this would make keeping the home. 10 = a system he will use weekly; 1 = nothing practical.
homekeeper.quest_style: One chore, fix or organising job.

mind.name: Mind
mind.looks_for: Mindset and wellbeing: motivation, discipline, focus, confidence, handling setbacks, stress and calm, creative blocks. Pull the strongest quotes and the one belief or habit worth adopting.
mind.score_means: How much this would shift his mindset or habits for the better. 10 = a reframe or practice he will keep; 1 = empty hype.
mind.quest_style: One reflection, practice or habit for today.

steward.name: Steward
steward.looks_for: Money management: budgeting, saving, spending decisions, bills, investing basics, gear buying decisions, cutting waste.
steward.score_means: How much this would improve his finances if applied. 10 = a concrete money move; 1 = no actionable advice.
steward.quest_style: Review, cut or plan one money item.

explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.looks_for: Travel and new experiences: places, trips, planning and booking tips, culture, things to try locally and abroad.
explorer.score_means: How much this would shape a real trip or new experience. 10 = something he will plan; 1 = just scenery.
explorer.quest_style: Add a place or idea to Plans, or plan one outing.

connector.name: Connector
connector.looks_for: People: friendships, family, networking, communication, conflict, showing up for others, building a community around his music.
connector.score_means: How much this would improve his relationships or network. 10 = a habit or message he will act on; 1 = nothing to apply.
connector.quest_style: Reach out to, catch up with or do something for one person.

builder.name: Builder
builder.looks_for: Building tools and systems: coding, AI, automation, RPGACE itself, productivity tooling, technical skills.
builder.score_means: How much this would improve what he is building. 10 = a technique or tool he should add; 1 = nothing usable.
builder.quest_style: Try one tool, write one note for RPGACE or automate one task.
